description: Changes Uptime Kuma server settings. Pass only what should change; every other setting keeps its stored value. Returns the settings as saved. Turning login off (disableAuth: true) needs currentPassword and leaves the dashboard open to anyone who can reach it. Read the current values with getSettings.

checkUpdate.description: Show when a new Uptime Kuma version is available

chromeExecutable.description: Path of the Chrome or Chromium binary real-browser monitors run, e.g. "/usr/bin/chromium". "" auto-detects. Changing it restarts the browser.

currentPassword.description: The admin password. Required only to turn login off (disableAuth: true) while it is on; never stored or returned.

disableAuth.description: true turns login off: anyone who can reach Uptime Kuma gets full control. Needs currentPassword. false turns login back on and logs out every other session.

domainExpiryNotifyDays.description: Days before a domain registration expires to send a warning. Replaces the whole list.

entryPage.description: What "/" opens: "dashboard", or a status page as "statusPage-<slug>". Find slugs with listStatusPages.

globalpingApiToken.description: Globalping API token, used by globalping monitors. A credential: "***" (what read tools return) keeps the stored token, "" clears it.

includeSecrets.description: Return credentials in full instead of "***"; they then stay in the transcript. Default: false, or UPTIME_KUMA_INCLUDE_SECRETS.

keepDataPeriodDays.description: Days of heartbeat history to keep; older beats are deleted

nscd.description: Cache DNS lookups with NSCD (Docker images only)

primaryBaseURL.description: The public address of this Uptime Kuma, used for links in notifications, e.g. "https://status.example.com". "" clears it.

prometheusApiEnabled.description: Collect Prometheus metrics. Changing it starts or stops the collection.

searchEngineIndex.description: Let search engines index status pages

serverTimezone.description: IANA timezone the server shows times and schedules maintenance in, e.g. "America/Edmonton" or "UTC"

steamAPIKey.description: Steam Web API key, used by Steam game server monitors. A credential: "***" (what read tools return) keeps the stored key, "" clears it.

tlsExpiryNotifyDays.description: Days before a TLS certificate expires to send a warning, e.g. [7, 14, 21]. Replaces the whole list.

trustProxy.description: Trust X-Forwarded-* headers. Set only when Uptime Kuma sits behind a reverse proxy.

name: updateSettings

settings.description: Uptime Kuma server settings after the change

apiEnabled.description: API access enabled (the "API" switch in Settings > General)

chromeExecutable.description: Chrome/Chromium path for real-browser monitors; empty = auto-detect

globalpingApiToken.description: Globalping API token for globalping monitors

steamAPIKey.description: Steam Web API key for Steam game server monitors
